name: Roa
source:
Daughter of Lavis. A senior officer in the demon king's army. She is a strong-willed and noble person.
As the child of a respected mother, she puts forth no effort to humiliate herself. Because of this, she is strict with others.
She is in love with a demon man who is close to her and wants to improve herself as a woman in order to become his wife.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1173186]Getchu[/url]]
